text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Estate Duty (Chew Chee Thong, Deceased) (Remission) Order 2015.

2. The sum of $896,397.61 payable under the Act on the Estate of Chew Chee Thong, Deceased, being the remaining 50% of the interest on the unpaid estate duty from 8 November 1994 to 31 December 2007 (both dates inclusive), is remitted.
